_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score band and 12h coil statistics dominate; no proven breaker, so stay on Panic rung until band break.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Panic; narrative silent on forward phase but risk-off tone does not contradict
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G/composite holds 24-31 and BTC stays inside ~1.5% with flat funding over next 12-24h
next_move.invalidated_if: Composite breaks below 23 (Capitulation) or above 32 (Denial), or a >2.3% directional day fires the thin Tue/first-3 setup
